cards.name: Whitewater Naiads
cards.oracle_text: Constellation — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters, target creature can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Aether Swooper
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
Whenever this creature attacks, you may pay {E}{E}. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.

cards.name: Renegade Silent
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, goad up to one target creature you don't control and put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. This creature phases out. (Treat it and anything attached to it as though they don't exist until your next turn.)

cards.name: Sound the Trumpets
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell. If that spell's mana value was 2 or less, recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)

cards.name: Nanoform Sentinel
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature becomes tapped, untap another target permanent. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Unwelcome Sprite
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library. You may put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Ghostly Flicker
cards.oracle_text: Exile two target artifacts, creatures, and/or lands you control, then return those cards to the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Shipwreck Patrol
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, tap target creature an opponent controls and put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)

cards.name: Ensign Pavel Chekov
cards.oracle_text: Strange new worlds — When Ensign Chekov enters, each opponent exiles the top X cards of their library, where X is the number of differently named lands you control. For each opponent, choose a land card that player owns exiled this way. You may play the chosen cards for as long as they remain exiled.

cards.name: Reality Shift
cards.oracle_text: Exile target creature. Its controller manifests the top card of their library. (That player puts the top card of their library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. If it's a creature card, it can be turned face up any time for its mana cost.)
